notes: Variant assumption is an overhead cable elbow extension with shoulders flexed overhead and upper arms mostly fixed. Visible role is Triceps brachii only. Head-specific evidence is summarized under the aggregate triceps mesh because local anatomy does not provide long-head, lateral-head, or medial-head entries. Shoulder and trunk support were not listed because the reviewed sources primarily support positional control rather than a concise app-facing muscle role.
